batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b B Lee

batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b B Lee

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b L Balaji

batting.name: P Dogra
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b SP Narine

batting.name: AD Mascarenhas
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b R Bhatia

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c AD Mascarenhas b PP Chawla

balls.text: flicks out a yorker and bowls Chawla, who had backed away but could not get the bat down in time
comes down the track, but gets a thick edge past the keeper as he has a go at the offbreak
swings a full delivery over the bowler, long off gets around to it
driven down to long on, cannot get underneath this one
catch taken in the Punjab dugout, Gilchrist skips out and lofts it just over Tiwary at long on
hit to deep midwicket for one, no way Gilchrist is going to be able to run tight twos
swung away to deep square leg, he did not go hard at that, played it a shade tentatively

incredible work from McCullum on the long on rope, Chawla had teed off and it looked headed for six, McCullum leaped in the air for the catch, saw he had gone over the rope, parried the ball in before reaching the ground beyond the rope, and came back in to keep them to two
Bisla has dropped this one, Chawla top-edging a pull, Yusuf came in from short fine, Bisla went back, the ball went through the keeper's gloves, and he backed straight into Yusuf
Narine saves four at short third man, Gilchrist had slashed this one hard, Narine got down quickly to his right to stop it on the bounce
makes room outside leg, Balaji follows him with a length ball, worked through square
low full toss hit hard along the ground to long on
full delivery down to long on for one
hit in the air down to sweeper cover
punched straight to extra cover
pushes a full delivery down to long off
another one goes, tries to fetch it from way outside off and slog-sweep, almost falls over as he stretches too much, and deep midwicket takes the catch safely in the end
worked with the angle to deep midwicket
tries to hit him out of the ground, ends up slicing it for long on to settle under it, it was the slower one from Bhatia
around the blockhole outside off, pushed away to sweeper cover
forced down to long on
slices it high in the air over cover, does not carry to sweeper cover
worked through midwicket
on the pads and picked away past short fine leg
backs away and tries to crash it over extra cover, beaten by the bounce on the short delivery
drops a back of a length ball towards point
mistimes an attempted pull in front of square
nearly chopped on to the stumps, trying to arch back and force a rising delivery towards point, inside edges it
controls the short ball well and swings it down to fine leg
goes back and defends a back of a length ball to extra cover
reaches out and pushes to sweeper cover
worked through square leg
pushed towards point

Punjab going nowhere at the moment, another big wicket, Hussey is run out by a long way, and it is the same man who ran Hussey out in Kolkata, Paras Dogra, who has managed to do it again in Mohali, pushed towards cover, no chance of completing a single there, they still decide to go for it

Marsh is gone now, underedging the attempted cut off a slow shortish and wide delivery from Lee, Marsh checks with Bisla whether it carried to him behind the stumps, Bisla nods, and Marsh walks away, not exactly sure that carried though, Punjab owner Preity Zinta does not think so,
he was making room outside leg, Lee bowled a slow bouncer, Hussey had top hop to reach the ball and swatted it to midwicket
opens the face to run it from off behind point
backs away to a full ball around off and times it to sweeper cover
slow length ball from Lee widish outside off, he ends up mistiming it to extra cover
pushes a pitched up ball from the crease straight to extra cover
cannot find timing on this slowish length ball, gets it down to long on
slams a pitched up ball down to long off
tucked away behind square leg again
inside edged on to pad behind square leg, he would have been plumb but for that little bit of bat on ball
super timing, takes a run and a big dive from Lee to his left at long on to save four, Marsh timing the clip too well
underedges it towards the keeper as he looks to guide this one through point
slow offcutter from outside leg, he dabs it softly in front of point
ending just outside off with the incoming angle, he waits on it and pushes it past point
beaten, Hussey wafts at a length ball from the crease, and it goes past the outside edge
bends the knee and steers one going across to third man
Marsh seems to have woken up, gets front foot out out of the way and smashes a length ball past the non-striker
tucked away to deep square leg
pushed down to long on
worked off the pads to deep backward square
slapped away down to sweeper cover
length ball pushed back to the bowler
opens the face and runs it down to short third man
cannot time the stroke as he comes forward to one angled across on a length, takes on an advancing mid off for a sharp run and makes it in the end
slow short ball on leg, Marsh swivels but he cannot connect
pushes a length ball to point, was expecting it to bounce more than it did
Mandeep departs, he skips down the track but ends up slicing this length ball to third man, the ball straightened as Mandeep charged out, and that is what did the batsman in
worked towards mid on for a single
wants the single with a push behind point, but just makes it back as the throw comes in

pulled away again, this time long on cuts it off, the throw was at the bowler's end, there would have been a run-out had it been at the keeper's, Mandeep was halfway down the pitch hoping for the second
not that short, but he is quick to open up and pull it between deep midwicket and long on
makes room and steers it from middle and leg to short third man
down the track, cannot get to the pitch and turns it towards square leg in the end
length ball worked with the spin to midwicket
punched down to sweeper cover
defends a back of a length ball around off and middle back to the bowler
allows a length ball to come in with the angle and pushes it wide of sweeper cover, they come back for the second, Mandeep dives in to make his ground
worked down to fine leg
slower one arrives from Balaji, comes in from outside leg stump, he takes it on the pad
nearly played on, he comes forward and tries to drop a shortish one on to the pitch, it came in just a bit, and he managed an inside edge just past the stumps
pushes a back of a length ball down to sweeper cover, Balaji finding bounce immediately
another one spinning away, but slowly and slightly wider as well, he plays late and guides it past slip
beaten on the cut as this one turns away sharply outside off
flicks this one on a good length, does not turn in, but straightens, defended off the front foot
pushes a full offbreak to point
this one turns in and bounces, he works with the spin square on the leg side
straightening outside off stump from a shortish length, pushed towards point
steers a climbing delivery wide of third man
shapes for another pull this time, but inside edges it from some way outside off on to pad, ball misses the stumps, they scamper for the single
slightly short, and he fetches it from off to pull without fuss over midwicket
back of a length ball forced off the pads to deep square
looks to go leg side again but ends up pushing a straight length ball to the bowler
tucks this one off the pads, and its timed well enough to reach the deep midwicket rope
leading edge as he looks to tuck a fullish one on the leg side, the ball rolls away towards extra cover
straight on middle and leg, worked wide of mid on
too short, bit of width, and he pushes it in the gap past cover
straightish delivery on middle, pushed to the bowler
offbreak turns and bounces outside off after pitching on leg, pushed to mid on
pushed straight to mid off, a clean pick up could have tested Gilchrist as he charged for the single
adjusts for the bounce to guide this widish one to the right of point, who dives to take pace off it
skiddy length ball pushed wide of mid off for a single
pitched up this time, around middle and off, he plays from the crease and pushes towards mid off
good length, on off stump, pushed to mid off
worked through midwicket
gone this time, tried to force a shortish delivery through the off side from the crease, it bounced and moved away, Bisla did well to snap up the thick edge

well played, on the rise, it also moves away a shade, he punches from the crease, Balaji scrambles to his right at third man, and cuts off the four with a dive, the ball rolls away but Balaji is up in time to stop it again, Gilchrist wanted a third, Valthaty wasn't looking back at his partner
back of a length ball softly dabbed in the air down to third man from very close to the body
forced away to mid on from the crease
pulled behind square leg, short fine gets a hand to it, deep square runs around to field
width for the cut, and Gilchrist goes for the shot, does not time it that well again, but enough to dispatch it between cover and backward point
punched from the crease wide of cover for a quick single
hops on his toes to push a rising delivery, this pitch has some bounce alright, down to third man
turned past midwicket for one
he winds up for the big pull, but mistimes the stroke, it sails safely over mid on though
the shortish delivery got onto him too quickly, and he could not time the pull, gets it away weakly through square
back of a length, worked off the pad to square leg
pitched up and just a push in to the pitch, which shows off its bounce as the ball then goes screaming over Lee's outstretched hand, no chance for mid off, or mid on, that was timed too straight
Lee digs it in short at Gilchrist, who swivels and pulls him, not with lots of control, on the bounce to deep square
into Valthaty from a shortish length, rolls away off the pad square
right on the stumps from back of a length, pushed away from the crease on the leg side
this one carries down the leg side from short of a length, appreciable bounce though
sharp away movement for Lee, the ball starts to shape away just before pitching on a good length on off stump, Valthaty is beaten by a long way
away first ball with a tuck towards midwicket off a back of a length ball that came in a tad
that will be it then, Kallis ends it with another skip down the pitch, and lofts the tossed up ball straight over the bowler

oh what an effort from David Hussey running to his left from long off, he must have run yards and yards, reached out one-handed as the ball came down after having been lofted by Kallis, but Hussey tumbled over with all his momentum in the end, and the ball rolled into the ropes
slashes a turning ball to short third man
steered to third man
gets out of the crease and across, and works behind square
drive to extra cover
now he pulls as Mascarenhas digs it in short, gets it away to deep midwicket
worked through square leg off the pad
excellent placement, that was almost on to off stump before he turned the face of the bat and it went purring past short third man
worked to deep square
leaving the crease to almost every delivery, stops after taking a couple of steps out, and squeezes the full delivery through cover
comes down the track, and opens the face to squeeze a full ball through point
turned to midwicket
dropped at midwicket, he charged out, looking for the clip past midwicket, but hit it close to the fielder, PK dived to his left, got a hand to the ball, but that was a tough chance
driven to long off along the ground
fine stroke, skips out, makes room as well and drives to sweeper cover, that is fifty for the KKR captain, not much of a celebration, for those who were expecting a big one
tries to drive down the ground but takes it full on the pads as he leaves the crease
this one carried in with the angle, but Kallis was in the crease, hadn't committed and dabbed it wide of short third man
defends a flighted ball
pushes with the turn in the air to long on
charges out once more, again he is too close to the pitch, Bhatt gets a hand to the push, parries to midwicket
goes hard at the drive, gets it down to sweeper cover
gets too close to the pitch as he skips out, digs it towards extra cover who parries it to long off
shot! takes on the flighted delivery, gets front foot out and times the drive just past extra cover
comes down the track, Bhatt shortens it, and Kallis has to defend
drives an angled length ball to long on
punched straight to extra cover
tries to dab a rising delivery very late, but is beaten
pulled to deep square leg
gets bat in front of pad to push a bouncing length ball to the bowler
safe straight push to long off to a length ball
nudged off the pads behind square
comes outside the crease and pushes it to long on
driven neatly down to long off
that looked pretty straight, Gautam missing the paddle as he bent his knee to one on off, need replays to see how close that one was
drives a tossed up delivery down to sweeper cover
pushed to cover off the front foot
turns a skiddy length ball off pad towards square leg
bowled 'em, Chawla gets another one, straightish length ball, did not turn, Bisla was shaping up for the cut, and chopped it on
pushed towards cover
appeal for leg before as he is hit on the pad as he comes forward to tuck through midwicket, misses, but this one was going down leg
defended off the front foot
turned through vacant midwicket off the front foot
short third man is not going to cut that off despite a dive, he only manages to change its direction towards the rope, that was a neat late dab from Gautam
again he backs away, and slaps it through extra cover now
that has been cracked for six over mid off, he made room, and flat-batted the back of a length ball
punched to extra cover from the crease
that is a very fine take, it was the slower one bowled with a legbreak sort of action, well down leg, Gilchrist got across pretty quickly to collect it
driven to mid off
beaten as he tries to run an away going length ball to third man
cut towards point
collects this time but Gautam is in the crease even as he is beaten

clearly not Punjab's night this, Gilchrist has fluffed a straightforward stumping, Bisla was done in by the flight, the delivery did not turn, came in with the angle, and off his pads to Gilchrist, who could not collect it, it rolled in front of the stumps, Bisla was so far out he had given up, Gilchrist got to the ball, not exactly swiftly, and flicked it back towards the stumps, and again missed
down the track comes Gautam this time and clips it through midwicket
down the track, not quite to the pitch, but scoops it over the bowler's head safely in the end
opens the face as he makes room to slice a skiddy one outside off to sweeper cover
down to long off for one
that looked close enough for a shout, Punjab's appeal was a muted one, replays show the ball angled in and struck him quite high, explains the lack of interest from Punjab
this time he gets on his toes and runs a back of a length ball on the stumps to third man
dabs a length ball from middle but straight to backward point
pushed towards midwicket
carefully pushes a length ball to the bowler, he had pushed one in the air to Mascarenhas in Kolkata
shows the bat as soon as he is struck in front on the pads to indicate there was an inside edge

what was that ball? and even more than that, what has Baz done? absolute rubbish long hop, short, way down the leg side, Baz could have done whatever he wanted with it, he has hit it straight to short fine leg, the fielder did not have to move at all, what a waste of a wicket, Chawla cannot belive it, he is down on his knees, and grinning sheepishly
charges out to a length ball but mistimes it on the bounce to mid off
and again, pulls the shortish one, to deep midwicket this time
short, too short, and Gautam is immediately into position for the pull, there is deep midwicket, so he has hit it just in front of square
sliding on to middle and leg, turned behind square
on the pads once again, and it is taken for two behind square again
worked off the pad behind square leg, and another easy two is added
shot! that wasn't wide enough for the cut, but Gautam has seemingly decided not to leave much for the middle order unlike the previous game, times the cut, and it races past point
wide of third man for a couple
poor line from PK, on the pads and he is put away past short fine
off the pads in front of square, keeper goes after it
they are going after Harmeet, Gautam goes for one of his favourite strokes, the loft over extra cover and connects superbly
struck high on the thigh pad, shout for lbw, that was too high
that was timed alright, down the track comes Gautam and clips it comfortably over deep midwicket
connects with a pull now and bashes it to deep midwicket
bit of shape away from the left-hander, ending on middle, worked towards midwicket
leading edge as he pushes at a length ball, it goes over point
PK bowls a maiden to McCullum, of all batsmen, he punches a length ball to extra cover
goes for the shot again, it got onto him quickly, and he mistimed it to mid on
and he cannot connect with another pull this time
swivels for the pull but cannot connect
pushed out to backward point
holding its line on off, defended
two is the call as soon as he clips this one through midwicket, and an easy two is taken
opens the face and runs it in front of point for one
oh, and then, next ball he decides to let one go outside off
Baz is in a tearing hurry as always, goes back  and across and forces a back of a length ball through vacant midwicket
diving stop at point saves four, Marsh throwing himself to his left to get a hand to the cut from Gautam
worked off the pad to short fine leg, Gautam wants the single, is sent back late in the end
bounces and straightens from back of a length, guided to a diving Harmeet at short third man,
but the line is ending on leg stump, and McCullum swivels to pull with the movement behind square leg
he charges out and muscles a length ball from outside off over midwicket
dabbed down to third man
smashes a length ball off the front foot, but it goes straight to cover
swings in to the pads, and rolls away square on leg
